data.title: 伊莉雅丝菲尔 · 圣杯战争
data.description: 烈火燃烧的废墟战场上，娇小的伊莉雅傲然端坐在庞大如巨山的狂战士（Berserker）肩头，狂风肆虐吹乱她的银白长发。她俯视着战场发出银铃般清脆的笑声——「Berserker，把阻挡在大哥哥面前的敌对从者全部碾碎！这就是爱因兹贝伦的力量！」
data.location: 冬木市燃烧的街道废墟
data.promptProse: Illyasviel, her long white hair spilling over a fur-trimmed purple coat, points ahead from Berserker's shoulder. The wild-haired giant carries her high above the ground, his massive chest and thick forearms outlined against the fires. A low, wide view holds them both from the girl's pointing hand down to his feet on the broken paving.
data.animaCaption: White-haired Illyasviel points from one shoulder of Berserker, a towering, broad-chested giant with wild charcoal hair and thick forearms. His feet brace against the broken paving below her.
